:::{#thm-prob-positive}
#### Probability of a positive test

Let $\text{sens}$ be the [sensitivity](#def-sensitivity) of a diagnostic test,
$\text{spec}$ its [specificity](#def-specificity),
and $\prev$ the [prevalence](#def-prevalence) of the disease.
Then the probability $\Pr(+)$ that the test is positive is:

$$
\Pr(+) =
\text{sens} \cd \prev
+ \paren{1 - \text{spec}} \cd \paren{1 - \prev}
$$ {#eq-prob-positive}

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-prob-positive, worked in @sol-prob-positive.

:::
